title: Pound to Euro Week Ahead Forecast: GBP/EUR Opens Higher as Trump Exempts Tech
text: The Pound to Euro (GBP/EUR) exchange rate opened the new week higher (1.15649, +0.40%) after markets reacted to news that Donald Trump had excluded imports of smartphones and laptops from his tariffs on China. title: EUR/GBP climbs toward 0.8700 as risk sentiment improves
text: EUR/GBP remains stronger for the third successive session, trading around 0.8670 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency cross appreciates amid improved risk sentiment after US President Donald Trump announced less severe tariffs late Sunday on Chinese imports, including semiconductors and electronics.

title: ING Forecast: Timing the GBP/EUR Bottom, Rebound Likely from 16-month Lows
text: After hitting 16-month lows below 1.1450 last week amid serious market turmoil, the Pound to Euro (GBP/EUR) exchange rate has rallied to 1.1560. ING expects soft UK data this week which could drive GBP/EUR to re-test 16-month lows just below 1.1450, but is also sees scope for a rebound if there is a more dovish ECB stance at Thursday's.

title: Goldman Sachs Forecast: GBP/EUR Prediction Slashed to 1.1630
text: The Pound to Euro (GBP/EUR) exchange rate plunged to 16-month lows below 1.1450 last week amid a renewed Euro surge. There was a recovery to 1.1565 on Monday as risk appetite recovered amid an element of relief over the latest US U-turn on tariffs from the Trump Administration.

title: Pound Euro Exchange Rate News: GBP/EUR Climbs amid Risk-Positive Trade
text: Looking forward, some high-impact UK data is due out through the first half of this week, starting with the British labour market overview on Tuesday morning. Markets expect to see UK unemployment hold steady while wage growth accelerates slightly.

title: EUR/GBP Price Analysis: Pair dips near range low despite bullish backdrop
text: EUR/GBP edged lower on Tuesday after the European session, retreating toward the bottom of its intraday range while holding just above key technical levels. The pair was last seen near the 0.8500 area, down modestly on the day, yet broader signals still point to underlying bullish strength.

title: EUR/GBP holds positive ground above 0.8550 after UK CPI inflation data
text: The EUR/GBP cross gains momentum to near 0.8565 during the early European session on Wednesday. The Pound Sterling (GBP) weakens against the Euro (EUR) after the UK Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation report.

title: EUR/GBP: Raising the profile – ING
text: EUR/GBP has held up better than expected, buoyed by euro strength and pressure on sterling from rising gilt yields. While a dovish ECB may cap gains short term, eurozone fiscal stimulus and rate hike expectations in 2026 could drive the pair higher over time, ING's FX analysts Francesco Pesole and Chris Turner note.

title: GBP/USD Rockets Higher While EUR/GBP Slips
text: On the hourly chart of GBP/USD at FXOpen, the pair remained well-bid above the 1.2850 level. The British Pound started a decent increase above the 1.3000 zone against the US Dollar.

title: EUR/GBP Price Analysis: Cross gains traction near 0.8600 despite neutral oscillators
text: The EUR/GBP pair extended its upside momentum during Wednesday's session, climbing toward the 0.8600 area after a 0.45% daily gain. Price action stayed mid-range between 0.85193 and 0.85765, with the bullish tone underpinned by the broader moving average structure, even as short-term oscillators signaled some hesitation.

title: EUR/GBP holds below 0.8600 ahead of ECB rate decision
text: The EUR/GBP cross attracts some sellers to around 0.8590 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The Euro (EUR) weakens against the Pound Sterling (GBP) as the European Central Bank (ECB) is anticipated to deliver a 25 basis points (bps) rate cut later in the session.

title: EUR/GBP trades in the red below 0.8600 mark ahead of ECB rate decision
text: The EUR/GBP cross struggles to capitalize on the previous day's goodish rebound from the 0.8525-0.8520 area or a fresh weekly low and attracts some intraday sellers on Thursday. Spot prices remain depressed below the 0.8600 mark through the first half of the European session, though the downside remains cushioned as traders opt to wait on the sidelines ahead of the key central bank event risk.

title: GBP/EUR Forecast: Sterling Set to Ease Gradually Over Coming Year
text: The latest exchange rate forecasts from Raboabank indicate GBP/EUR at 1.18 in one month, suggesting near-term resilience in sterling. However, the outlook then softens modestly, with GBP/EUR anticipated to slip to 1.16 at both the three- and six-month horizons.
